# Buttons and toggles markup reference

Buttons, drop-down buttons, toggles, check boxes, radio buttons, and segmented controls.

### SegmentedBase

Receiver: `SegmentedBase` and derived types (`where T : SegmentedBase`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `ItemPadding(Thickness value)` | `ItemPadding` | Sets the per-segment padding; the strip height follows the control, so use a small value for a compact, icon-only strip. |
| `ItemTemplate(IDataTemplate template)` | `ItemTemplate` | Sets the segment template. |
| `Items(IReadOnlyList<T> items, Func<T, string> textSelector = null, Func<T, object> keySelector = null)` |  | Sets ItemsSource to a view over the items, one segment each, with an optional text selector. |
| `Items(params string[] items)` |  | Sets ItemsSource to a view over the strings, one segment each. |
| `ItemsSource(ISelectableItemsView itemsSource)` | `ItemsSource` | Sets the items source. |
| `Sizing(SegmentSizing value)` | `Sizing` | Sets how segments are sized along the horizontal axis. |

### ButtonGroup

Receiver: `ButtonGroup`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `ItemTemplate(Func<TemplateContext, FrameworkElement> build, Action<FrameworkElement, TItem, int, TemplateContext> bind, Action<FrameworkElement, TItem, int, TemplateContext> unbind = null)` |  | Sets the segment template for a ButtonGroup using delegate-based templating. |
| `ItemTemplate(Func<TemplateContext, TElement> build, Action<TElement, TItem, int, TemplateContext> bind, Action<TElement, TItem, int, TemplateContext> unbind = null)` |  | Sets the segment template; the bind callback receives the root the build callback returned. |
| `ItemTemplate(Func<TemplateContext, TElement> build, Action<TElement, TItem> bind)` |  | Sets the segment template from a root element and a bind callback that needs only the item. |
| `PrepareContainer(Action<SegmentButton, T, int> prepare)` |  | Configures each ButtonGroup segment container after its content is bound. Use it to assign Command, subscribe to Click, or configure IsCheckable / IsChecked (independent toggle), enabled state, or tooltip. |

### DropDownButton

Receiver: `DropDownButton`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `BindContent(ObservableValue<TSource> source, Func<TSource, string> convert, bool accessKey = true)` | `bind Content` | Binds the drop-down button content to a converted observable value (creates a centered text label). |
| `BindContent(ObservableValue<string> source, bool accessKey = true)` | `bind Content` | Binds the drop-down button content to an observable string value (creates a centered text label). |
| `Content(string text, bool accessKey = true)` | `Content` | Sets the drop-down button content to a centered text label. When accessKey is true (default), "_" prefixes mark access key characters (e.g., "_Export" registers Alt+E). |
| `DropDownMenu(Menu value)` | `DropDownMenu` | Sets the menu the drop-down opens. |
| `IsDropDownOpen(bool value = true)` | `IsDropDownOpen` | Sets whether the menu is open. |
| `MaxDropDownHeight(double value)` | `MaxDropDownHeight` | Sets an upper bound on the menu height; the default is no bound. |
| `OnDropDownClosed(Action handler)` | `event DropDownClosed` | Subscribes handler to DropDownClosed. Occurs after the menu closed. |
| `OnDropDownOpening(Action handler)` | `event DropDownOpening` | Subscribes handler to DropDownOpening. Occurs right before the menu opens, so items can be rebuilt. |

Receiver: `SegmentedControl`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `BindSelectedIndex(ObservableValue<TSource> source, Func<TSource, int> convert, Func<int, TSource> convertBack = null)` | `bind SelectedIndex` | Binds the selected index to a converted observable value (e.g. an enum). |
| `BindSelectedIndex(ObservableValue<int> source)` | `bind SelectedIndex` | Binds the selected index to an observable value. |
| `ItemTemplate(Func<TemplateContext, FrameworkElement> build, Action<FrameworkElement, TItem, int, TemplateContext> bind, Action<FrameworkElement, TItem, int, TemplateContext> unbind = null)` |  | Sets the segment template using delegate-based templating. |
| `ItemTemplate(Func<TemplateContext, TElement> build, Action<TElement, TItem, int, TemplateContext> bind, Action<TElement, TItem, int, TemplateContext> unbind = null)` |  | Sets the segment template; the bind callback receives the root the build callback returned. |
| `ItemTemplate(Func<TemplateContext, TElement> build, Action<TElement, TItem> bind)` |  | Sets the segment template from a root element and a bind callback that needs only the item. |
| `OnSelectionChanged(Action<object> handler)` | `event SelectionChanged` | Subscribes handler to SelectionChanged. Occurs when the selected segment changes. |
| `PrepareContainer(Action<SegmentButton, T, int> prepare)` |  | Configures each segment container after its content is bound. The callback receives the container, the item, and its index; use it to set or bind any container property (enabled state, tooltip, etc.). Applied on every rebuild. |
| `SelectedIndex(int value)` | `SelectedIndex` | Sets the selected segment index (-1 means no selection). |
| `SelectedItem(object value)` | `SelectedItem` | Sets the currently selected item object, or when nothing is selected. |

### Button

Receiver: `Button` and derived types (`where T : Button`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `BindCommand(ObservableValue<Command> source, CommandPresentationMode presentation = None)` | `bind Command` | Binds the button's semantic command to an observable value. |
| `BindContent(ObservableValue<Element> source)` | `bind Content` | Binds the button content element to an observable value. |
| `BindContent(ObservableValue<TSource> source, Func<TSource, Element> convert)` | `bind Content` | Binds the button content element to a converted observable value. |
| `BindContent(ObservableValue<TSource> source, Func<TSource, string> convert, bool accessKey = true)` | `bind Content` | Binds the button content to a converted observable value (creates a centered text label). |
| `BindContent(ObservableValue<string> source, bool accessKey = true)` | `bind Content` | Binds the button content to an observable string value (creates a centered text label). |
| `Command(Command command, CommandPresentationMode presentation = None)` | `Command`, `CommandPresentationMode` | Sets the semantic command invoked by the button. |
| `CommandPresentationMode(CommandPresentationMode value)` | `CommandPresentationMode` | Sets which command presentation parts are used as generated content; the default is None. |
| `Content(string text, bool accessKey = true)` | `Content` | Sets the button content to a centered text label. When accessKey is true (default), "_" prefixes mark access key characters (e.g., "_Save" registers Alt+S). |
| `OnCanClick(Func<bool> predicate)` | `event CanClick` | Sets the predicate asked whether the button can be clicked. |
| `OnClick(Action handler)` | `event Click` | Subscribes handler to Click. Occurs when the button is clicked. |
| `OnDoubleClick(Action handler)` | `event DoubleClick` | Adds a left-button double click handler. |

### CheckBox

Receiver: `CheckBox` and derived types (`where T : CheckBox`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `BindContent(ObservableValue<TSource> source, Func<TSource, string> convert, bool accessKey = true)` | `bind Content` | Binds the content to a converted observable text label. When accessKey is true (default), "_" prefixes in the converted text mark access key characters. |
| `BindContent(ObservableValue<string> source, bool accessKey = true)` | `bind Content` | Binds the content to an observable text label. When accessKey is true (default), "_" prefixes mark access key characters and stay in sync as the source changes. |
| `BindIsChecked(ObservableValue<TSource> source, Func<TSource, bool?> convert, Func<bool?, TSource> convertBack = null)` | `bind IsChecked` | Binds the checked state to a converted observable value. |
| `BindIsChecked(ObservableValue<bool> source)` | `bind IsChecked` | Binds the checked state to an observable value. |
| `BindIsChecked(ObservableValue<bool?> source)` | `bind IsChecked` | Binds the checked state to an observable nullable value. |
| `Check()` | `IsChecked = true` | Sets IsChecked to true. |
| `Content(string text, bool accessKey = true)` | `Content` | Sets the content to a text label. When accessKey is true (default), "_" prefixes mark access key characters (e.g., "_Remember me" registers Alt+R). |
| `Indeterminate(bool isIndeterminate = true)` |  | Sets IsChecked to null, the indeterminate state. |
| `IsChecked(bool? isChecked = true)` | `IsChecked` | Sets the checked state; null is indeterminate. |
| `IsThreeState(bool value = true)` | `IsThreeState` | Sets whether the check box supports the indeterminate state. |
| `OnCheckStateChanged(Action<bool?> handler)` | `event CheckedChanged` | Adds a CheckedChanged handler that receives the three-state value. |
| `OnCheckedChanged(Action<bool> handler)` | `event CheckedChanged` | Adds a checked changed event handler. |
| `ThreeState()` | `IsThreeState = true` | Sets IsThreeState to true. |
| `Uncheck()` | `IsChecked = false` | Sets IsChecked to false. |

### SegmentButton

Receiver: `SegmentButton`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `BindCommand(ObservableValue<Command> source)` | `bind Command` | Binds the semantic command invoked by a segment button. |
| `IsCheckable(bool value = true)` | `IsCheckable` | Sets whether a mouse click flips IsChecked (independent toggle). |
| `IsChecked(bool value = true)` | `IsChecked` | Sets the active-fill visual state (selected or toggled-on). |
| `OnCheckedChanged(Action<bool> handler)` | `event CheckedChanged` | Subscribes handler to CheckedChanged. Occurs when IsChecked flips due to a click (checkable segments only). |
| `OnClick(Action handler)` | `event Click` | Subscribes handler to Click. Occurs when the segment is activated by a mouse click or keyboard input. |
